records.text: Owens said Robert Kraft, the billionaire owner of the New England Patriots and their stadium, mounted a pressure campaign that succeeded in having Macklemore canceled as Ed Sheeran's opening act.

records.notes: Owens alleges that Kraft used pressure to cancel Macklemore as Sheeran’s opening act after pro-Palestine remarks, presenting the stadium as an example of powerful actors suppressing that speech.
